title: Jev Bundle Specification — manifest v2
description: Machine-readable description of .agents/jev-bundle/<name>/bundle.json with schema_version 2. The runtime validator in src/jev_loop/bundles/manifest.py is the authority, and tests/test_bundle_manifest_schema.py checks with a real Draft 2020-12 validator that the two descriptions agree on the shipped corpus and on a generated per-field matrix in spec/bundle-examples/. They are not fully equivalent, and the difference is listed rather than claimed away. This schema cannot express: that the manifest must be a regular file of at most 256 KiB read with a bound and valid UTF-8 JSON; that nesting depth is limited to 16 levels; that the manifest's directory name must equal name and BUNDLE.md must exist next to it inside the bundle; that python_path must exist and resolve inside the bundle directory; that declared contract schemas are validated as closed definitions with cross-field bound rules; that declared config defaults are cross-checked against config_schema; that the bundle directory is scanned for unrendered template tokens; and the lexical integer-token rule, because JSON has a single number type while the runtime requires an integer token for schema_version and for integer bounds (schema_version 2.0 and minItems 1.0 are accepted by this schema and refused by the runtime). Present optional metadata must have its declared non-null type: an explicit null is rejected here and by the runtime, while omitting the field stays valid.

name.description: Must equal the bundle directory name.

entrypoint.description: module:function. Only this shape is enforced; python_path bounds the extra import search path rather than confining imports, and whether the module exists, where it is imported from and the factory's return type are not checked statically.

python_path.description: Relative to the bundle directory; for schema_version 2 it must resolve inside the bundle directory.

config.description: Default config passed to the factory as {**config, **bundle_config}.

inputs_schema.description: Checked against task.inputs before a run is created, and against an inputs update.

config_schema.description: Checked against the merged config before a run is created.

items.description: An environment variable name only: uppercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, and no whitespace at all (a trailing newline is rejected here exactly as the runtime rejects it). The value itself is never echoed by a diagnostic.

credential_env.description: Environment variable names only. Never a value, never a file path.

resources.description: Advisory expectation. The run's real claims come from the caller's resource_keys.

stop.description: Advisory intent. The enforced bound is the run's stop_grace_seconds.

verification.description: Advisory intent. This report does not establish that the verifier is independent.

scaffold.description: true marks an unfinished generated scaffold; the host refuses to start it by default.

contractSchema.description: A schema inside the service's closed subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties (literal false only), items, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum. Unsupported keywords are rejected instead of ignored.

proseText.description: A v2 prose field: non-empty and without surrounding whitespace, matching the runtime rule exactly (an explicit null is not accepted either; omit the field instead).

proseList.description: A list of exact prose entries: no surrounding whitespace, no empty entries.
